title: Robotlar da Çorap Giyer
author: Resul Aydoğan
description: Game designer Res and robot designer Pes invite young readers into their workshop to meet four playful robots, each with a different emotion, favourite shape and special way of moving. To bring Muni, Buri, Bubu and Medi to life, children must observe their expressions and buttons, match each robot with the right pair of socks, and join in by jumping, balancing, spinning and counting. The adventure ends with the workshop’s biggest robot yet, and an open-ended activity inviting readers to design its socks and decide how it should move.
